1.consolidated_definition: Planta perenne, con la base de los tallos engrosada, hojas cordado-ovadas, inflorescencia axilar y fruto carnoso, oblongo, de color verde. CucurbitaceaeDoyerea emetocathartica.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Perennial plant with thickened base of stems, cordate-ovate leaves, axillary inflorescence and fleshy fruit, oblong in shape, green in color. Cucurbitaceae Doyerea emetocathartica.
